categories.rationale: An axiom states a limit and its consequences, so the reader needs the limit, how it is approached and held, why it is load-bearing, what breaks short of it or moving away from it, and how distance from it is observed.
A definition is only usable if it also says what it excludes, so Boundaries is required rather than optional; a definition that only says what a thing is leaves every adjacent case undecided.
Closeness of fit must be judgeable without reading the implementation, which requires the duty, the contract and the fit criteria to be stated separately.
A document type is instantiable only when its required sections and its acceptance condition are both stated, and acceptance must be an observation rather than prose about quality.

A trait decides whether axioms bind, so a reader must be able to apply it to their own system: it states what the characteristic is, an observable test, where its edges are, which axioms it brings into force, and why the obligation follows from the characteristic.

charters.rationale: A charter is a set's vision and its operating instructions, and these are the questions every set asks in the same form: what end state it approaches, what it covers and how it grows, how it is analysed and changed, what an unhealthy population looks like, and what is in it. Boundaries and composition must be answered too, under headings of the set's own choosing.
